sidebar.offline: Runs on this Mac. Nothing leaves it.

sub.first: Hold the shortcut, talk, let go. Your words land wherever the cursor is.
sub.returning_one: You've talked instead of typed on {{count}} day so far.
sub.returning_other: You've talked instead of typed on {{count}} days so far.

hotkey.title: Dictate
hotkey.push_to_talk: Hold to talk, let go to paste.
hotkey.toggle: Tap to start, tap again to paste.
hotkey.hold_or_toggle: Hold to talk, or tap to keep listening.

command.title: Command mode
command.body: Select text, hold, say what to change. Nothing selected and it writes at the cursor.
command.examplesLead: Things to say in command mode:

status.off: Cleanup is off. Text pastes as you said it.
status.down: Ollama isn't running, so text pastes raw.
status.missing-model: {{model}} isn't installed, so text pastes raw.

last.timed_out: Last: {{app}}, ran out of time, pasted raw

recent.title: Recent
recent.empty: Nothing yet. Hold this and say something:

sound.label: Sounds
sound.note: Soft G♯ tones when recording starts and stops, and when the text lands.

volume.label: Sound volume
volume.note: How loud the start, stop and landing tones are. You'll hear the start tone when you let go of the slider.

media.label: While you dictate
media.leaveNote: Other sound keeps playing and may end up in the recording.
media.muteNote: Your Mac goes silent while the mic is open, then the sound comes back. Videos keep playing silently.
media.pauseNote: Music, podcasts and videos pause while you talk and pick up where they left off. Calls are left alone.

login.label: Open at login
login.note: Starts in the menu bar, ready for the shortcut.

handy.label: Built on Handy
handy.note: Recording, transcription and pasting come from Handy by CJ Pais, used under the MIT License. Copyright (c) 2025 CJ Pais.

cleanup.lede: A model running in Ollama on this Mac tidies each dictation before it's pasted. It never translates and never adds things you didn't say.

enabled.label: Clean up dictations
enabled.note: Off pastes exactly what the speech model heard.

model.label: Model
model.note: Any model you've pulled into Ollama.
model.down: Can't reach Ollama. Start it with “ollama serve”.

level.label: Edit level
level.lightNote: Keeps your wording. Drops the ums and restarts, fixes punctuation, turns spoken lists into lists.
level.polishedNote: Rewrites what you said into clear, well-ordered sentences, like Typeless. Same meaning, same language, nothing added. Takes a few seconds longer.

budget.label: Time limit
budget.note: If the model is slower than this, the raw transcript goes in instead.
budget.polishedNote: Polished has its own limit. Long dictations need more time; past the limit, the raw transcript goes in instead.

server.label: Ollama
server.note: Only this Mac. Remote addresses are refused.

dictionary.title: Dictionary
dictionary.lede: Names, jargon, the words it keeps getting wrong. Terms are handed to Whisper before it listens. “Heard as” fixes whatever still slips through.
dictionary.addPlaceholder: Add a word, name or acronym
dictionary.empty: Nothing here yet. Start with the word you correct most.

styles.title: Styles
styles.lede: L.O.B.A checks which app you're in. Chats stay loose, email gets tidied up, and code or terminals get exactly what you said.
styles.literalNote: No model. Dictionary fixes only, so commands and code arrive untouched.
styles.appsNote: Matched by app name or bundle ID.
styles.titlesNote: For apps that live in a browser tab. If the window title contains this word, the style applies. That's how Gmail in Safari gets email tone.

history.title: History
history.lede: Your last 50 dictations. Click one to copy it.
history.empty: Nothing yet. Hold the shortcut and say something.

outcome.timed_out: Ran out of time, pasted raw

transcribe.name: Dictate
transcribe.note: Talk, let go, and the text is pasted where you're typing.

loba_command.name: Command mode
loba_command.note: Select text, say what to change, let go. The selection is rewritten.

mode.label: Dictate by
mode.push_to_talkNote: Hold to talk, let go to paste. Presses under 0.3 s are ignored, so other ⌥⌘ shortcuts still work.
mode.toggleNote: Tap once to start and again to paste. Avoid this with a modifier-only shortcut like ⌘⌥.
mode.hold_or_toggleNote: Hold to talk, or tap to keep listening. Avoid this with a modifier-only shortcut like ⌘⌥.

dialog.title: New {{name}} shortcut
dialog.body: Press the keys you want and let go. Modifiers on their own work too, like ⌘⇧.
dialog.captured: Got it. Save, or press something else.

problem.plain: A single key would fire while you type. Add a modifier.
problem.failed: Couldn't set that shortcut. Try another.

meetings.title: Meetings
meetings.lede: Record a call and get a recap. L.O.B.A writes down what you said and what the others said, then sums it up. Everything stays on this Mac.
meetings.noSystemAudio: Only your microphone is being recorded, so the other people on the call won't be in the transcript. To hear them, allow L.O.B.A under Screen & System Audio Recording, then start a new meeting.
meetings.listening: Listening. Text shows up here every few seconds while people talk.
meetings.empty: No meetings yet. Start one when a call begins, and stop it when the call ends.
meetings.recapFailed: No recap: {{reason}}. Check that Ollama is running, then write it again.
